item.title: Neon Genesis Evangelion: Δ Cross Reflections Will Be Playable At Live Events This Year
item.description: A demo of Evangelion: Δ Cross Reflections will be playable throughout the year at live events all around the world.

item.title: Space Control Coming to Meta Quest & PC VR Soon, Demo Out Now
item.description: Inspired by animated series like Rick & Morty and Futurama, Space Control is an absurd and comic VR game with a Steam Next Fest demo available now.

item.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: Empire City Demo Leaves Us Wanting More
item.description: The Steam Next Fest Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: Empire City demo leaves us wanting the full release ASAP.

item.title: Sherlock Holmes: The Master Detective Hands-On: Uneven Investigations
item.description: Sherlock Holmes: The Master Detective is the latest VR adaptation of the iconic detective, delivering uneven investigations in Early Access.

item.title: Titan Isles Launches Today On PlayStation VR2
item.description: Titan Isles, a high-mobility action-adventure shooter, lands on PlayStation VR2 today.

item.title: Apple Vision Pro's Retrocade Is The Virtual Arcade We've Been Waiting For, With A Catch
item.description: Retrocade is the nostalgic virtual 1980s arcade experience VR gamers have been waiting for, and arguably the best visionOS title yet, but multiplayer is sorely missing.

item.title: The Amusement Demo Impressions: An A-Maze-ing Premise With Weak Roomscale
item.description: The Amusement shows a lot of potential as a narrative puzzler, but its implementation of roomscale movement may push players away early in the demo.

item.title: Graphics Depicting Meta's Next Headset Found In Quest Firmware
item.description: Graphics depicting Meta's upcoming ultralight headset with a tethered compute puck, codenamed Phoenix, have been found in Quest firmware.

item.title: Sci-Fi Job Sim Space Control Is Equal Parts Charm & Cringe
item.description: Drawing inspiration from Rick & Morty and Futurama, Space Control is an absurd adult-oriented VR job simulator that makes some players laugh, and others cringe.

item.title: Hitman World Of Assassination Gets Limited-Time Mission Starring Milla Jovovich
item.description: A free Hitman World of Assassination Elusive Target mission starring Milla Jovovich from the Resident Evil films is available to play until March 24.
